description: Phileas Fogg, Passepartout and Abigail Fix race eastward from London across Europe, Asia, the Pacific and America, with Fogg’s wager repeatedly threatened by danger, sabotage and his own inexperience.

s01e01.description: Fogg wagers that he can circle the globe in eighty days and leaves London with Passepartout, soon joined by journalist Abigail Fix.

s01e02.description: Crossing Italy, Fogg faces an arrogant industrialist and must overcome his self-doubt when a railway disaster leaves a child in danger.

s01e03.description: Stranded on Yemen’s coast, Fogg and Passepartout attempt a dangerous desert crossing while Abigail is left to fend for herself.

s01e04.description: In India, a disrupted wedding and military trouble force the travellers into another delay while tensions within the group deepen.

s01e05.description: Passepartout’s history in Hong Kong becomes vital when Fogg’s money is blocked, while Abigail’s latest article threatens to humiliate Fogg.

s01e06.description: Cast away in the Pacific, the fractured trio must survive together as betrayals, apologies and old regrets finally surface.

s01e07.description: Crossing the American West, the travellers share a stagecoach with a lawman and prisoner whose pursuers turn the journey into a violent race.

s01e08.description: In New York and on the final journey home, Fogg confronts sabotage, lost time and a personal reunion as the eighty-day deadline closes in.
